نستجل (form X)
# نَسْتَجْلِ (nastajli) /nas.tad͡ʒ.li/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
# نُسْتَجْلَ (nustajla) /nus.tad͡ʒ.la/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
